name: context-outline-vscode
summary: This VS Code extension displays a project's .context-outline/root.json as a sidebar tree and lets users open the source behind each map item. It can copy AI prompts and context references, or launch Claude Code and Copilot CLI in a terminal to build or expand the map.

children.title: 1. VS Code activates when a workspace already has a map
Create the Context Outline sidebar and Project Map view
Offer map-building actions when no map exists
Let users disable either terminal AI integration
2. The extension builds and keeps the project map tree current
Read root.json from every workspace folder
Skip folders with no map or an empty map
Warn when a map contains invalid JSON
Show each map root expanded with its summary and revision
Use the folder name when the map has no name
Turn each map node into a clickable tree item
Reload when a map is changed, created, deleted, or workspace folders change
3. Clicking a map item opens and highlights its source
Accept one line or a line range and convert it to editor positions
Show an error instead of opening a missing file
Clamp requested lines to the end of the document and highlight them
4. Users can copy the selected map context or bundled AI prompts
Copy one or more selected item titles as map references
Prefer the multi-selection and include the right-clicked item if needed
Ask users to select an item before copying
Read a bundled prompt and copy it to the clipboard
Expose copy, prompt, refresh, and open-map commands in the tree
5. Users can run an AI CLI in the chosen project folder
Define Claude Code and Copilot launch arguments
Start Copilot interactively with the prompt
Find and cache the CLI before starting a terminal
Search PATH, common install directories, and tool-specific directories
Use the login shell as a final non-Windows lookup
Show an install error when the requested CLI cannot be found
Build a map in the only folder or ask users to choose among folders
Give the AI the clicked item's full path and source location for detail requests
